sentences.text: Sie ist reich, aber nicht glücklich.
Wie ist er so reich geworden?
sentences.en: How did he get so rich?

sentences.text: Ich möchte nicht reich sein, nur glücklich.
sentences.en: I don't want to be rich, just happy.

sentences.text: Reich ist, wer viele Freunde hat.
sentences.en: Rich is the one who has many friends.
sentences.review: The English 'Rich is the one who has many friends' is stilted and reads like a word-for-word rendering of the German proverb structure; suggest 'Whoever has many friends is rich.' or 'He who has many friends is rich.'

sentences.text: Mit dieser Idee wirst du reich.
sentences.en: You'll get rich with this idea.
